# snipeit_fieldset (Resource)

Manages a custom fieldset in Snipe-IT. Fieldsets group custom fields and are attached to asset models. Use `snipeit_field_fieldset_association` to add fields to a fieldset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_fieldset" "laptop" {
  name = "Laptop Details"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the fieldset. Must be unique.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the fieldset.
